source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: USDA’S Collection of Nonfat Dry Milk (NDM) Recipes, USDA Food and Nutrition Service, Food Distribution Service

ingredients.name: water, to mix with the dry milk

steps.instruction: Mix 2/3 cup of non-fat dry milk with 2 cups of water.
Add the milk, 1/8 teaspoon of salt and 2 3/4 cups of water to a small saucepan.
Heat over medium heat until steaming hot, but not boiling.
Add 2 cups of quick cooking oats, stirring until creamy.
steps.spoken: Add the oats and cook, stirring, for 1 to two minutes, until creamy.

steps.instruction: Take the pan off the heat.
Stir in 2 mashed ripe bananas and 2 tablespoons of maple syrup.
Top with 2 tablespoons of chopped walnuts.
